Definition: bare spot, i.e. in the glaring sun
BiblicalUsage: tsᵉchîychîy names bare spot, i.e. in the glaring sun. It appears once, in Nehemiah 4:13.
TheologicalSignificance: My position: tsᵉchîychîy carries the precision of a God who says what He means.
